credit_ledger_delta_sign.name: credit_ledger_delta_sign
credit_ledger_delta_sign.value:
("credit_ledger"."kind" IN ('grant','pack','refund') AND "credit_ledger"."delta" > 0)
          OR ("credit_ledger"."kind" IN ('debit','expiry') AND "credit_ledger"."delta" < 0)
          OR ("credit_ledger"."kind" = 'adjust')

credit_ledger_lot_expiry.name: credit_ledger_lot_expiry
credit_ledger_lot_expiry.value: "credit_ledger"."kind" NOT IN ('grant','pack','refund') OR "credit_ledger"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL

credit_ledger_free_allowance_ref.name: credit_ledger_free_allowance_ref
credit_ledger_free_allowance_ref.value: "credit_ledger"."ref_type" IS DISTINCT FROM 'free_allowance' OR "credit_ledger"."ref_id" IS NOT NULL

pause_periods_ended_known.name: pause_periods_ended_known
pause_periods_ended_known.value: "pause_periods"."ended_known_at" IS NULL OR "pause_periods"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL

brain_docs_active_is_confirmed.name: brain_docs_active_is_confirmed
brain_docs_active_is_confirmed.value: "brain_docs"."status" <> 'active' OR ("brain_docs"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "brain_docs"."confirmed_content_sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "brain_docs"."activated_at" IS NOT NULL)

frameworks_shared_has_no_owner.name: frameworks_shared_has_no_owner
frameworks_shared_has_no_owner.value: "frameworks"."visibility" <> 'shared' OR ("frameworks"."owner_profile_id" IS NULL AND "frameworks"."workspace_id" IS NULL)

frameworks_private_has_owner.name: frameworks_private_has_owner
frameworks_private_has_owner.value: "frameworks"."visibility" <> 'private' OR ("frameworks"."owner_profile_id" IS NOT NULL AND "frameworks"."workspace_id" IS NOT NULL)

frameworks_confidence_matches_evidence.name: frameworks_confidence_matches_evidence
frameworks_confidence_matches_evidence.value:
CASE
            WHEN jsonb_typeof("frameworks"."evidence_entries") <> 'array' THEN false
            WHEN jsonb_array_length("frameworks"."evidence_entries") = 0 THEN "frameworks"."confidence" = 'unsupported'
            WHEN jsonb_array_length("frameworks"."evidence_entries") = 1 THEN "frameworks"."confidence" = 'single_case'
            WHEN jsonb_array_length("frameworks"."evidence_entries") < 5 THEN "frameworks"."confidence" = 'repeated'
            ELSE "frameworks"."confidence" = 'contrasted'
          END

generation_attempts_vendor_start_recorde.name: generation_attempts_vendor_start_recorded
generation_attempts_vendor_start_recorde.value:
"generation_attempts"."state" NOT IN ('vendor_started','vendor_complete','settled','recovery_required')
          OR "generation_attempts"."vendor_started_at" IS NOT NULL

generation_attempts_vendor_completion_re.name: generation_attempts_vendor_completion_recorded
generation_attempts_vendor_completion_re.value:
("generation_attempts"."state" NOT IN ('vendor_complete','settled') OR "generation_attempts"."vendor_completed_at" IS NOT NULL)
          AND ("generation_attempts"."state" NOT IN ('claimed','vendor_started') OR "generation_attempts"."vendor_completed_at" IS NULL)
